rule.en: Throw knives through the gap in the spinning spiked ring to slice the apple.
rule.sw: Rusha visu kupitia nafasi ya pete inayozunguka ukate tufaha.

en: Tap, or press Space, to throw a knife.
Time it so the knife flies through the gap in the spiked ring.
Ten knives. The ring spins faster with every knife you use.
sw: Gusa, au bonyeza Space, kurusha kisu.
Lenga kisu kipite kwenye nafasi ya pete yenye miiba.
Visu kumi. Pete inazunguka kwa kasi zaidi kila kisu unachotumia.

desc.en: Two players, one phone. One throws; the other spins the ring to block every knife. Then swap.
desc.sw: Wachezaji wawili, simu moja. Mmoja anarusha; mwingine anazungusha pete kuzuia kila kisu. Kisha mnabadilishana.

native.notation: D01+D12+D13 | V02+V09-style drag × U01+U03 ⊕ M06+M31 → S04+S11 → P01 [O02 on kati]

source.en: kati, the Kenyan street game where throwers try to hit the dodgers
source.sw: kati, mchezo wa mtaani ambapo warushaji hujaribu kuwapiga wanaokwepa

rule.en: Stop the sliding saw at exactly 50 cm. Three cuts; the lowest total wins.
rule.sw: Simamisha msumeno kwenye sentimita 50 kamili. Mikato mitatu; jumla ndogo inashinda.

en: The saw slides along a 100 cm plank.
Tap, or press Space, to cut when it's at 50 cm.
Three cuts, each faster. Your score is the total distance off.
sw: Msumeno unateleza juu ya ubao wa sentimita 100.
Gusa, au bonyeza Space, kukata ukiwa kwenye 50.
Mikato mitatu, kila mmoja kwa kasi zaidi. Alama ni jumla ya umbali uliokosea.

desc.en: No guide line and no numbers until all three cuts are done. Judge the half by eye.
desc.sw: Hakuna mstari wa mwongozo wala namba hadi mikato yote mitatu imalizike. Pima nusu kwa macho.

native.notation: D01 | V02 × U01+U10 ⊕ M44 → S03 → P03 [O05 on Igisoro]

source.en: Igisoro, where masters never count their seeds openly
source.sw: Igisoro, ambapo mabingwa hawahesabu mbegu waziwazi

rule.en: Tap when the power bar is right to shoot into the hoops; higher hoops score more.
rule.sw: Gusa nguvu ikiwa sawa urushe mpira kikapuni; vikapu vya juu vina alama zaidi.

en: The power bar rises and falls. Tap, or press Space, to shoot.
A little power reaches the near hoop; a lot sends the ball to the top. Watch the wind.
Five balls. A clean swish scores 50% extra.
sw: Kipimo cha nguvu kinapanda na kushuka. Gusa, au bonyeza Space, kurusha.
Nguvu kidogo inafika kikapu cha karibu; nguvu nyingi inapeleka mpira juu. Angalia upepo.
Mipira mitano. Kuingia bila kugusa pete kunaongeza 50%.

desc.en: Before each shot you may call a hoop. A called hit scores double; a called miss scores nothing.
desc.sw: Kabla ya kila kurusha unaweza kutaja kikapu. Ukipata ulichotaja alama ni mara mbili; ukikosa, sifuri.

source.en: Kadi, where you must declare "Niko Kadi!" before you're allowed to win
source.sw: Kadi, ambapo lazima utangaze "Niko Kadi!" kabla ya kuruhusiwa kushinda

rule.en: Hold to fire the jetpack and keep the tomato off the spikes.
rule.sw: Shikilia kuwasha jetpack na uiepushe nyanya na miiba.

en: Hold anywhere, or hold Space, to fire the jetpack. Let go to drop.
Stay between the spikes and dodge the mines.
Bronze, Silver, Gold and up to Legend. In a challenge you race your friend's ghost.
sw: Shikilia popote, au shikilia Space, kuwasha jetpack. Achia kushuka.
Baki kati ya miiba na ukwepe mabomu.
Shaba, Fedha, Dhahabu hadi Gwiji. Kwenye changamoto unashindana na kivuli cha rafiki yako.

desc.en: Crash, and you can send a rescue link. A friend who catches your falling tomato within 10 seconds brings you back, and you carry on from the crash.
desc.sw: Ukianguka, unaweza kutuma kiungo cha uokoaji. Rafiki akidaka nyanya yako ndani ya sekunde 10 anakurudisha, na unaendelea ulipoanguka.

source.en: kati, where catching the ball brings an eliminated player back
source.sw: kati, ambapo kudaka mpira humrudisha mchezaji aliyetolewa

rule.en: Tap arrows to slide them off the board, without letting one hit another.
rule.sw: Gusa mishale iteleze nje ya ubao, bila mmoja kugonga mwingine.

en: Tap an arrow and it slides out the way it points.
If something is in the way it bumps and you lose a heart. Clear every arrow to finish.
Keyboard: arrow keys move the yellow ring between arrows, Enter taps.
sw: Gusa mshale nao utateleza kuelekea unakoelekeza.
Kitu kikiwa njiani unagonga na unapoteza moyo. Ondoa mishale yote kumaliza.
Kibodi: vitufe vya mishale vinasogeza pete ya njano kati ya mishale, Enter inagusa.

desc.en: Double-headed arrows don't cost a heart when blocked: they reverse and leave by the tail. Blocked both ways, they stay put.
desc.sw: Mishale yenye vichwa viwili haipotezi moyo ikizuiwa: inageuka na kutoka kwa mkia. Ikizuiwa pande zote, inabaki ilipo.

source.en: Giuthi, where sowing reverses direction when the last seed lands in an occupied pit
source.sw: Giuthi, ambapo upandaji hugeuka mwelekeo mbegu ya mwisho ikiangukia shimo lenye mbegu

rule.en: Slide the caps until the gold cap drops down the chute into the glass.
rule.sw: Teleza vifuniko hadi kifuniko cha dhahabu kidondoke kwenye glasi.

en: Tap a cap next to an empty space to slide it, or swipe it the way it should go.
Get the gold cap (with the star) to the bottom-right corner, over the chute.
Match the fewest possible moves for three stars. Keyboard: arrows to choose a cap, Enter to slide, Shift+arrow to push it.
sw: Gusa kifuniko kilicho karibu na nafasi tupu ukiteleze, au kisukume upande unaotaka.
Fikisha kifuniko cha dhahabu (chenye nyota) kona ya chini kulia, juu ya mfereji.
Fikia idadi ndogo kabisa ya hatua upate nyota tatu. Kibodi: mishale kuchagua, Enter kuteleza, Shift+mshale kusukuma.

desc.en: On odd-sized boards the gold cap must pass through the centre, the water, before it may exit.
desc.sw: Kwenye bao za ukubwa wa witiri, kifuniko cha dhahabu lazima kipite katikati, majini, kabla ya kutoka.

native.notation: D01 | V01 × U02 ⊕ M32-style constraint → S08 → P02 [O11 on Shisima]

source.en: Shisima, where a winning line must run through the centre: the water
source.sw: Shisima, ambapo mstari wa ushindi lazima upite katikati: majini

rule.en: Swipe to cut the lemon and drain the pieces without flies into the glass.
rule.sw: Pangusa kukata ndimu na umimine vipande visivyo na nzi kwenye glasi.

en: Swipe all the way across the lemon to cut it.
The piece without flies drops and drains into the glass. Fill it to 100%.
Cut through a fly and it's over. Each lemon brings more flies and fewer cuts.
sw: Pangusa kuvuka ndimu yote kuikata.
Kipande kisicho na nzi kinadondoka na kumiminika kwenye glasi. Ijaze hadi 100%.
Ukikata nzi, mchezo umekwisha. Kila ndimu ina nzi zaidi na mikato michache.

desc.en: When you send a challenge, you place the flies first. Your layout becomes your friend's board.
desc.sw: Unapotuma changamoto, unapanga nzi kwanza. Mpangilio wako unakuwa ubao wa rafiki yako.

source.en: Kiothi, where a player may redistribute one pit's seeds anywhere on the board before play
source.sw: Kiothi, ambapo mchezaji anaweza kugawa upya mbegu za shimo moja popote kabla ya mchezo

rule.en: Dive the wreck with rival divers, grab treasure, and get back before the air or Papa the shark runs out your luck.
rule.sw: Piga mbizi kwenye mabaki na wapinzani, chukua hazina, urudi kabla hewa au Papa hajakumaliza.

en: Roll to dive, take treasure, then turn back for the jahazi. Every treasure you carry slows you and drains the shared tank.
Papa the shark rises each round. If he reaches you, feed him a treasure or lose all you carry. Deep tiles may be mimics.
Three dives. Only treasure you bring back to the boat counts.
sw: Rusha kete kuzama, chukua hazina, kisha rudi kwenye jahazi. Kila hazina unayobeba inakupunguza kasi na kumaliza tangi la pamoja.
Papa anapanda kila raundi. Akikufikia, mlishe hazina au upoteze vyote unavyobeba. Vigae vya chini vinaweza kuwa vya udanganyifu.
Mbizi tatu. Hazina unayoirudisha jahazini pekee ndiyo inahesabiwa.

desc.en: Before dive 1 you may move one tile anywhere in the trench. Lift gold shallow for a safer grab, but rivals can take it too.
desc.sw: Kabla ya mbizi ya kwanza unaweza kuhamisha kigae kimoja popote kwenye mfereji. Pandisha dhahabu juu upate kwa urahisi, lakini wapinzani nao wanaweza kuichukua.

source.en: Kiothi, where one pit's seeds may be redistributed anywhere before play begins
source.sw: Kiothi, ambapo mbegu za shimo moja zinaweza kugawanywa popote kabla ya mchezo kuanza

rule.en: Move your three water bugs to make a line through the centre.
rule.sw: Sogeza wadudu wako watatu wa majini wafanye mstari unaopita katikati.

en: Tap one of your bugs, then an empty point next to it along a line.
Three in a row wins, but the line must pass through the centre: the water.
The same position three times is a draw. Keyboard: Tab to a point, Enter to pick and to move.
sw: Gusa mmoja wa wadudu wako, kisha nukta tupu iliyo karibu kwenye mstari.
Watatu kwa mstari wanashinda, lakini mstari lazima upite katikati: majini.
Mpangilio ule ule mara tatu ni sare. Kibodi: Tab kwenda nukta, Enter kuchagua na kusogeza.

source.en: Shisima, played by the Tiriki of western Kenya. The pieces, imbalavali, are water bugs racing to the water.
source.sw: Shisima, unaochezwa na Watiriki wa magharibi mwa Kenya. Vipande, imbalavali, ni wadudu wa majini wanaokimbilia majini.
